item.title: Hegseth warns Russia as signs point to Moscow sharing intel with Iran
item.summary: War Secretary Pete Hegseth warns Russia should stay out of Middle East conflict as reports emerge of Moscow allegedly providing intelligence to Iran.

item.title: Where American support for Trump’s Iran strikes stand as new polls roll in
item.summary: Most but not all of the latest national polls indicate majority opposition to the U.S. military strikes President Donald Trump ordered against Iran in Operation Epic Fury.

item.title: Alleged ISIS-inspired suburban terrorists lived 10 miles apart but were 'strangers' before NYC attack: Lawyer
item.summary: Two Pennsylvania men accused of ISIS-inspired terror plot in NYC allegedly threw explosive devices at protest. Prosecutors say act of terrorism.

item.title: Hero NYPD officers honored for foiling alleged ISIS-inspired terror plot near Gracie Mansion
item.summary: NYPD Chief Aaron Edwards and Sgt. Luis Navarro were honored by Mayor Zohran Mamdani after stopping an alleged ISIS-inspired terror attack near Gracie Mansion.

item.title: Tunnel to Towers announces 'Steel Across America' tour to mark 25 years since 9/11 attacks
item.summary: A 16,000-pound steel beam from the World Trade Center will travel 10,500 miles across America in a moving 9/11 memorial tour starting May 2.

item.title: Tennis star Mirra Andreeva erupts with profanity-laced tirade toward fans after Indian Wells defeat
item.summary: Mirra Andreeva flung her racket and screamed profanities at fans following her loss at Indian Wells, later expressing regret for her on-court outburst.

item.title: Cuban activist to Trump: ‘Make Cuba great again’ by ending communist rule
item.summary: Cuban activist Rosa María Payá appeals directly to Trump for support as Cuba faces rolling blackouts and food shortages amid deepening humanitarian crisis.

item.title: Philadelphia police release video of street fight that ended in fatal shooting, seek help in hunt for suspect
item.summary: Philadelphia police hunt for suspected gunman after deadly street fight caught on surveillance video from February and released Monday.

item.title: Israel commends 'courage' of Iranian women's soccer team as five players granted asylum in Australia
item.summary: Israel praised the Iran women's soccer team after players stayed silent during their national anthem at the Women's Asian Cup. Five secured asylum in Australia.

item.title: Android fixes 129 security flaws in major phone update
item.summary: Google released an Android update fixing 129 vulnerabilities, including a zero-day flaw linked to Qualcomm chips already exploited in attacks.
